turns.content: Propionaldehyde reacts with ethanedithiol (EDT) and BF3. Identify thioacetal intermediate A by structure or name.
A is treated successively with BuLi, bromoethane, and then HgCl2/H2O/H+. Identify product D and explain the alkylation and thioacetal deprotection steps.
Separately, 3-bromopentane reacts with PPh3 and then BuLi. Identify the resulting Wittig ylide and its carbon skeleton.
React ketone D with that ylide. Identify alkene E by condensed structure or name.
Describe a symmetry-based procedure for grouping E's carbon atoms into distinct 13C NMR environments.
Apply that procedure to E and count its distinct 13C environments.
Determine whether the alkyl precursor and product E are uniquely specified by the reaction sequence. Revise the symmetry assignment only if that analysis changes the proposed structure.
Partition the carbon atoms in the proposed structure of E into symmetry-equivalent sets and give the multiplicity of each set.
Report the final number of distinct 13C NMR signals.
